cards.ex: After the earthquake, we had to call for help because we were trapped.
cards.exUz: Zilziladan keyin, qamalib qolganimiz sababli yordamga chaqirishga majbur bo'ldik.

cards.ex: The flood completely wiped out the small village.
cards.exUz: Suv toshqini kichik qishloqni butunlay yo'q qildi.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay yo'q qilib tashlash, qirib yuborish.

cards.ex: Everyone needs to take shelter immediately; the tornado is approaching.
cards.exUz: Hamma zudlik bilan panoh izlashi kerak; tornado yaqinlashmoqda.

cards.ex: The emergency services arrived quickly after the accident.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisadan keyin favqulodda xizmatlar tezda yetib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Tez yordam, o't o'chiruvchilar va politsiya kabi xizmatlar.

cards.ex: The storm cut off power to several towns.
cards.exUz: Bo'ron bir nechta shaharlarga elektr ta'minotini uzib qo'ydi.

cards.ex: In the aftermath of the hurricane, many people were left homeless.
cards.exUz: Bo'ron oqibatida ko'p odamlar uysiz qoldi.

cards.ex: The number of wildfires is on the rise due to climate change.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi tufayli o'rmon yong'inlari soni o'sib bormoqda.

cards.ex: We got caught in a terrible storm on our way home.
cards.exUz: Uyga qaytayotganda dahshatli bo'ronga tushib qoldik.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir ichida qolib ketish, tutulib qolish.

cards.ex: It's too early to know the full extent of the damage from the earthquake.
cards.exUz: Zilziladan kelgan zararning to'liq ko'lamini bilishga hali erta.

cards.ex: The rescue workers searched through the rubble for survivors.
cards.exUz: Qutqaruvchilar xarobalar ostidan omon qolganlarni qidirishdi.
cards.uzDef: Buzilgan binolardan qolgan tosh va g'ishtlar.

cards.ex: A fire broke out in the building next door last night.
cards.exUz: Kecha kechqurun qo'shni binoda yong'in boshlandi.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga boshlanib ketmoq (yong'in, urush va h.k.).

cards.ex: We need to head for higher ground before the flood gets worse.
cards.exUz: Suv toshqini yomonlashishidan oldin yuqori joyga yo'nalishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: The injured man is in critical condition at the hospital.
cards.exUz: Jarohatlangan odam kasalxonada og'ir ahvolda.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy sog'liq muammolari bilan bog'liq og'ir holat.

cards.ex: We had a power outage after the storm.
cards.exUz: Bo'rondan keyin bizda elektr uzilishi bo'ldi.

cards.ex: The first responders need to assess the situation before they can help.
cards.exUz: Birinchi javob beruvchilar yordam berishdan oldin vaziyatni baholashlari kerak.

cards.ex: We should all be prepared for natural disasters.
cards.exUz: Biz hammamiz tabiiy ofatlarga tayyor bo'lishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: The fire spread rapidly because of the strong winds.
cards.exUz: Kuchli shamol tufayli yong'in tez tarqaldi.

cards.ex: People living near the coast are at risk of flooding.
cards.exUz: Sohil yaqinida yashovchi odamlar suv toshqini xavfi ostida.

cards.ex: You should take precautions before going hiking in the mountains.
cards.exUz: Tog'larda sayr qilishdan oldin ehtiyot choralarini ko'rishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xavfni oldini olish uchun choralar ko'rish.

cards.ex: The governor declared a state of emergency after the hurricane.
cards.exUz: Gubernator bo'rondan keyin favqulodda holat e'lon qildi.

cards.ex: We'll get through this crisis together.
cards.exUz: Biz bu inqirozni birgalikda yengib o'tamiz.

cards.ex: The wildfire was completely out of control.
cards.exUz: O'rmon yong'ini butunlay nazoratdan chiqib ketgan edi.

cards.ex: If you're feeling unwell, you should seek medical attention.
cards.exUz: Agar o'zingizni yomon his qilsangiz, tibbiy yordam izlashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Shifokorga murojaat qilish, davolanishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The earthquake trapped many people under the collapsed buildings.
cards.exUz: Zilzila ko'p odamlarni qulagan binolar ostida qamab qo'ydi.
cards.uzDef: Biror joyda qolib ketish, chiqib keta olmaslik.

cards.ex: There were reports of looting after the disaster.
cards.exUz: Ofatdan keyin talonchilik haqida xabarlar bo'lgan.

cards.ex: Many organizations are providing disaster relief to the affected areas.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab tashkilotlar zarar ko'rgan hududlarga ofatdan yordam ko'rsatmoqda.

cards.ex: The authorities issued an evacuation order for coastal areas.
cards.exUz: Rasmiylar sohil hududlari uchun evakuatsiya buyrug'ini e'lon qildi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli hududni tark etish haqidagi rasmiy buyruq.

cards.ex: The stress of the disaster is starting to take its toll on everyone.
cards.exUz: Ofatning stressi hammaga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsata boshladi.

cards.ex: Rescuers are working against the clock to find survivors.
cards.exUz: Qutqaruvchilar omon qolganlarni topish uchun vaqtga qarshi ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt bilan poyga qilish, juda tez harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The hurricane was a wake-up call about climate change.
cards.exUz: Bo'ron iqlim o'zgarishi haqida ogohlantiruvchi qo'ng'iroq bo'ldi.
